# Next Level Gaming & Novelties

> Turnkey interactive event rentals, live gaming event production, VR gaming arcades, sim racing cockpits, outdoor movie screens, 360 & mirror photo booths, and custom DIY novelty stations serving New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Connecticut, New England, and North Carolina.

- **Headquarters**: Rebel Rd, Hudson, NH 03051
- **Regional Branch**: North Carolina (Charlotte, Raleigh, Durham, Chapel Hill, Greensboro, Cary, Wilmington, New Bern, Asheville)
- **Phone**: 978-601-5473
- **Email**: sales@nextlevelgamingevents.com
- **Website**: https://nextlevelgamingevents.com/

## Core Rental Experiences
- [Live Gaming Events & Esports Production](https://nextlevelgamingevents.com/gaming-events): 12 ft to 40 ft HD screens, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, Nintendo Switch, retro NES consoles, bracket management, and FEC-scale tournament setups.
- [Virtual Reality & Mobile VR Arcade](https://nextlevelgamingevents.com/virtual-reality): Room-scale VR event games (SUPERHOT VR, Beat Saber, Pistol Whip, Job Simulator, Walkabout Mini Golf) and 4-player cooperative VR escape rooms.
- [Sim Racing Cockpit Simulators](https://nextlevelgamingevents.com/sim-racing): Commercial force-feedback steering wheels, bucket seats, live external telemetry displays, and fastest-lap leaderboards.
- [Photo Booths (360 Video & Magic Mirror)](https://nextlevelgamingevents.com/photo-booth): 360 slow-motion video booth platforms and full-length touch-screen Magic Mirror photo booths with red carpet, props, prints, and instant QR/SMS sharing.
- [Outdoor Movie Screens & LED Video Walls](https://nextlevelgamingevents.com/movie-nights): 16 ft to 40 ft inflatable drive-in cinema screens and 14 ft to 20 ft daylight-visible mobile LED video wall trailers.
- [Glow Park Experience](https://nextlevelgamingevents.com/glow-park): 8 illuminated truss-mounted LED glow swings, 4 glowing seesaws, uplighting, and glowing mini golf.
- [Silent Disco](https://nextlevelgamingevents.com/silent-disco): 3-channel tri-color glowing LED wireless headphones scalable from 50 to 5,000+ guests.
- [Just Dance Giant-Screen Parties](https://nextlevelgamingevents.com/just-dance): Multiplayer dance battles on 12 ft to 32 ft screens with concert sound.
- [Interactive Trivia Nights & Game Shows](https://nextlevelgamingevents.com/trivia-nights): Live-hosted trivia with wireless team buzzers and giant-screen leaderboards.
- [11 Custom Event Novelty Stations](https://nextlevelgamingevents.com/novelties): Patched City custom trucker hats & beanies, custom crew socks, Bead-tastics & intention bracelets, custom photo pillow dolls, reversible sequin pillows, laser-engraved keychains, hammerless stamped custom rings, Silly Sacks plush bags, and custom license plates.
